name: What type of paint finish should I choose for my interior walls?

mainEntity.name: What type of paint finish should I choose for my interior walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right paint finish depends on the room's function and desired aesthetic. Matte or flat finishes hide imperfections well and offer a sophisticated look, ideal for low-traffic areas like dining rooms or master bedrooms. Eggshell and satin finishes are more durable and easier to clean, making them popular for living rooms and hallways. Semi-gloss and gloss finishes are highly durable, very washable, and often used for trim, doors, or kitchens and bathrooms due to their moisture resistance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Paint finish choice depends on the room's use; options include flat (hides imperfections), eggshell/satin (durable, washable), and semi-gloss/gloss (very durable, moisture-resistant).
